tasks.title: plan save requires a human approval marker; forge plan approve --by writes it
tasks.objective: Make forge plan save set awaiting-approval and refuse approved unless a fresh .factory/plan-approval.json matches the plan body digest, and add a human-attributed forge plan approve --by that writes that marker, refused without --by — every existing plan-save gate preserved.
acceptance_criteria: plan save digests the plan BODY (excluding the machine-added frontmatter, using the existing body/header split), reads .factory/plan-approval.json, and sets plan_status approved ONLY when a marker exists and its plan_sha256 matches the body digest.

With no marker, or a marker whose digest does not match (an edit after approval), plan save writes the plan as awaiting-approval and refuses to approve, with a message telling the human to review in plan mode and run forge plan approve.

forge plan approve --by <name> digests the current active plan's body, writes .factory/plan-approval.json {plan_sha256, approver, at}, and is refused without --by. It is a human chat confirmation like decision accept.
Implementation stays blocked: update_run refuses the implementing phase while plan_status is awaiting-approval (its existing approved requirement, now reachable only through the marker).

Every existing plan-save gate runs first and unchanged: grill freshness, decisions_reviewed coverage, contradiction signals, and the Surface Impact section check. Their existing tests stay green with no weakening.
factory/prompts/planner.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md describe the review-in-plan-mode-then-plan-approve step.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "plan_save or plan_approve or awaiting or plan_gate or plan_approval"
tasks.reviewer_focus: That the digest is over the BODY the human approved, not the file with its machine frontmatter — otherwise the bind never matches and the gate is either always-open or always-closed. That NO existing plan-save gate was weakened to make the new flow pass (a relaxed grill/decisions/contradiction check is a blocking finding). And that forge plan approve is genuinely human-attributed — refused without --by — or it reopens the self-approval hole this story closes.
